name: Table 1, IC 2
setup: Table 1, IC 2 (Figs. 2–3, top right). Larger waves in both height (Ah = 0.45) and velocity (Av = 0.5). Inside the training range.
expect: A steepening, asymmetric wave profile at t = 200. The reduced models should be almost indistinguishable from the DNS; plain LLF should be visibly flattened.
observed: Both reduced models sit on the DNS (q error 0.23% NN, 0.34% MCL-NN) while plain LLF is off by 7%. The limiter barely acts because the network is already well-behaved here.
